name: kpss.test
title: KPSS level statistic. The long-run variance is the Phillips-Perron weighted sum.

origin.description: KPSS level statistic. The long-run variance is the Phillips-Perron weighted sum.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: KPSS level statistic. The long-run variance is the Phillips-Perron weighted sum.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
set.seed(11)
k <- kpss.test(rnorm(50))
paste(cell(k$statistic), cell(k$p.value), k$parameter, sep = "|")
